reference_evidence.type: Previously captured REA runtime screenshot of the same installed client version
observations: Column header counts open tasks; completed tasks are in a foldable subsection of the original column.
Subtasks expand inside the parent card with their own checkbox, content and schedule.

implementation: Keep closed roots in their original kanban columns and sort the column closed subsection by close time.
Preserve list and dedicated closed-page projections; cache groups by view mode.
Render parent and child rows in one card with shared task identities, actions and folding state.
Apply Hide Completed to closed roots and inline children.
skip_reasons: Four meeting integrations require explicitly enabled real Pi services.
One focus test requires the temporary XCTest host to become the active app.

flows.name: Inline expansion
flows.observed: Collapsing 需求评审 removed both child rows; expanding restored both original tasks.

flows.name: Child completion and restore
flows.observed: 准备议程 completed and restored from its own checkbox; parent stayed active and progress changed 0/2 → 1/2 → 0/2.

flows.name: Child selection
flows.observed: Clicking the child title opened 准备议程 details with the 需求评审 parent link.

flows.name: Child menu, date panel and undo
flows.observed: The child context menu set Tomorrow, and its own date text opened the shared date panel. Selecting Oct 18 and confirming updated the child; two separate undo actions restored Oct 17 and then the original undated state. The parent remained in its original date column.

flows.name: Last open root completion
flows.observed: Completing 联调与回归 changed Today open count 1 → 0, and Today closed subsection 1 → 2. The column and creation entry remained visible.

flows.name: Closed subsection folding
flows.observed: Folding Today hid both closed tasks, while its count remained 2; expanding made both accessible.

flows.name: Root restore and history
flows.observed: Restoring 联调与回归 returned it to the same column open area. Undoing restore and then completion returned the original state.

flows.name: Hide Completed
flows.observed: With one completed child, Hide Completed removed that child and both root closed subsections, preserving the unfinished child. Restoring the preference and undoing child completion restored the prior visible state.

native_acceptance.final_state: Display preference restored; named QA roots retain original status, children active, temporary child dates cleared; expanded kanban remains open for review.
